settings.title: Settings & Mutators
settings.aiDifficultyTip: Enemy AI difficulty. 0.0 = easy, 0.5 = normal, 1.0 = hardcore. Affects accuracy, reaction time and tactics.
settings.friendlyBotsTip: Number of friendly bots on your team. More bots = more help, but also more chaos.
settings.minEnemiesTip: Minimum enemy bots always active. Used when bBots is off - otherwise SoloEnemies controls this.
settings.maxEnemiesTip: Maximum enemy bots. Enemies scale between min and max based on player count.
settings.soloEnemiesTip: Fixed enemy count when bBots=True (friendly bots active). Replaces Min/Max Enemies.
settings.soloWavesTip: Number of enemy waves per objective. More waves = longer fight at each point.
settings.initialSupplyTip: Supply points to choose weapons and equipment. Higher = better loadouts from start.
settings.roundTimeTip: Time limit per round in seconds. 1200 = 20 minutes. When time runs out, your team loses.
settings.respawnWavesTip: Number of times your team can respawn. When all waves are used and you die, game over. +1 bonus per objective.
settings.roundsPerMapTip: How many rounds are played on one map before switching to next in MapCycle.
settings.respawnDelayTip: Seconds you wait before respawning after being killed.

mutators.NoDroppedWeapons: Killed players and bots don't drop their weapons
mutators.AllYouCanEat: Unlimited supply - take any equipment you want
mutators.BulletSponge: Enemies can take much more damage before dying
mutators.Guerrillas: Enemies only have pistols and melee weapons
